title: Self-Help Charge Posting Card: Community Rules & Site Care Resident Desk
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a self-help charge is posted for a violation notice the community cured itself, dated the day the contractor performed the work and referenced to that notice. The resident desk posts it on the plan record's rules and site-care statement.

## What the posting does

`post_self_help_charge_892a63af` adds one self-help charge, referenced to the violation notice that was cured and carrying the contractor's cost for the work and the total charged, to the statement of the named plan record, and raises the record's statement balance by the total. The resident sees the charge, dated the day of the work, on their rules and site-care statement.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the representative first unlocks `post_self_help_charge_892a63af` and then calls it on the resident desk's behalf. One call posts the charge for one cured notice.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rules_plan_id` | the reference number of the site-care plan record whose statement is charged, as returned by the site-care plan record lookup for the resident | identifier |
| `source_record_id` | the reference number of the violation notice the community cured, as returned by the rules records lookup for the plan record | identifier |
| `entry_date` | the date the community's contractor performed the cure | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date, no time of day, no time zone |
| `contractor_cost` | the contractor's cost for the work, in US dollars | non-negative number with 2 decimal places (cents); further digits are rounded half up |
| `amount` | the total self-help charge, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with status `posted`, showing the statement reference of the new charge, the plan record charged, the notice cured, the date of the work, the contractor's cost, the amount, and the statement balance once the charge is on it. The tool defines no other outcome.
